label: orig-phase step 2-3 input k/n/p/o/2 after g/y/c/q/0/3/w context
explanation: Fires almost only during the original phase at t=2 (54% of mass) and t=3 (45%). Nothing at t=0,1 or t>=5, and almost nothing on the delimiter or copy phase (<1% of mass). The current input is mostly k (38% of mass), n (27%), p, o or 2, and is nearly always the first occurrence of that token. Magnitude goes up when the preceding tokens include g, y, c, q, 0 or 3: the top examples look like "0 g g [k]" and "0 y g [n]", and first_tok=0 has 5x lift. It behaves like an additive threshold between the current token and the earlier context, so no clean boolean captures it. Step 2-3 with a k/n/p/o/2 input covers 90% of activations but has only 9% precision. Requiring the context tokens to have appeared earlier keeps 84% of the activation mass at 17% precision. The best dev F1 found was about 0.35.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: in_tok=k (+5.31), prev_tok=g (+3.89), t=2 (+3.84), orig_idx=2 (+3.84), prev_tok=y (+3.75), in_tok=p (+3.68). Lower it: orig0=u (-3.75), orig0=w (-3.72), orig0=v (-3.68), orig0=s (-3.51).
